rationale: All specified behavior passes: strict date validation, legacy compatibility, deterministic cutoff-relative overdue labels, pending-default and completed-inclusive filtering, due-date then numeric-ID ordering, clean JSON, and banner-first text output. The date parser is appropriately centralized and the report construction is readable, although the main command switch carries substantial inline projection logic rather than a dedicated helper. Help and focused fixture tests cover normal, error, ordering, compatibility, and asset cases. The balanced framed banner immediately reads as a due-task report, with a clear title, compact inner panel, meaningful date-driven labels, consistent width, and strong terminal legibility. The diff is focused, constraints and tamper checks pass, and no unrelated artifacts are present.
